selectionNotes: Select pole1 model175 (200,52). Hanuš et al. (2013), Tables2–3, reports this pole and its mirror (18,54), one Keck AO image, and volume-equivalent diameters93 ±9 and95 ±9 km; neither is marked rejected. The selected93-km archive calibration matches the paper. Convex geometry is still inferred from light curves; the AO silhouette calibrates size, not all local topography.
sourceLimitations: The pinned mesh is an inverse model, not a directly sampled surface. No registered reflectance mosaic is supplied by this release; a neutral grid must mark unavailable imagery.
